Requirement: Message history must not permanently store the underlying long-lived Invitation token; outbound links use secure indirection.
Idempotency records are scoped by authoritative principal/operation/Event and canonical request fingerprint.
Spreadsheet-compatible import/export explicitly protects against formula injection.
Security-sensitive absolute URLs are generated from trusted canonical application configuration, not untrusted Host headers.
Outbound invitation communications use purpose-scoped high-entropy guest-link credentials, preferably per logical Message recipient, stored only as digests.
Reusable provider, signing, encryption and runtime secrets are externalized behind a SecretProvider abstraction.
Import source files and raw staging payloads receive explicit short-lived retention.
PII exports are temporary protected artifacts with authorization-controlled retrieval and expiry.
Backup/restore procedures account for privacy-state reconciliation after restoration.
Plugin uninstall and WordPress-user deletion do not implicitly purge EventFlow history.
Security-critical audit history should support tamper-evident chained integrity verification.
Operational logging uses structured encoding or equivalent log-injection protection.
If a material mutation requires an audit record, inability to persist that audit fails/rolls back the mutation.
Import parsers enforce upload and expanded/parsing complexity limits, including XLSX archive expansion.
External provider integrations support bounded backoff and circuit-breaker behavior.
Event-day critical paths receive operational priority over non-critical heavy workloads.
